Native 1200x675 (verified by direct fetch), clears the Discover hero-card floor without cropping. Not Creative Commons; accepted under NEAR's operator-authorized tier-1 attribution/deep-link/removal policy for a venue's own official self-hosted photography, same tier as a business's own site or verified social account. Depicts a past club night inside the venue (2019), not a current-day storefront shot — building and programme areas confirmed unchanged via the current official site. Two in-body images (1363_large.jpg, 1373_large.jpg) drawn from the same official gallery under the same policy, credited to photographers Roel Determeijer (2011) and uncredited festival documentation (2012) respectively per the gallery's own captions.

statusHistory.note: Rotation item OT301 (manifest: content/_rotation-runs/2026-09-09-round-01/manifest.json, candidate OT301/Amsterdam/Tier 2, also batch-30 candidate). Full research session: history and ownership (Wikipedia, Amsterdam Alternative 20th-anniversary piece), current programme areas verified against the live official site (Ventilator Cinema/Bar, Studio 301, 4bid Gallery), De Peper's 2023 closure and replacement by Café Gilde caught and corrected against older sources that still describe De Peper as open — a currency check that mattered. Google Maps pin verified live via browser (52.3600834, 4.8656877), 4.6/580 reviews read for UGC (queue/phone-return/cheap-beer detail), practical entrance/accessibility notes (buzzer entry, no elevator) sourced from independent visitor commentary. Dated event: The Machine's Dutch debut, benefit night, Saturday 9 November 2026, confirmed directly on OT301's own agenda page (not just aggregator listings). Dedupe re-run clean against all 5 existing Amsterdam pins, nearest is Rush Hour at >1km. r/amsterdam search attempted twice (web search, then direct Reddit navigation) and blocked both times — substituted Google Maps reviews as the UGC leg per the fallback ladder; logged as a source-catalogue gap, not glossed. Preferred-sources.md has only one Amsterdam-relevant entry (Amsterdam Alternative); flagging the same catalogue thinness already noted there rather than forcing weak sources. Hero and two in-body images are real photos from OT301's own official online gallery, credited per licenseNote. All six locales, mechanical and Discover checks pass.
